Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis in this study consists of three main components: 1) Co-IP MS to identify Aurora-A binding partners (using ectopic expression of Flag-Aurora A), 2) In vitro kinase assay MS to identify phosphorylation sites on LDHB, and 3) Validation of the S162 phosphorylation site in cells using Aurora-A knockdown and cell cycle synchronization (S phase vs M phase). The extracted variables focus on the differential proteomics comparisons (knockdown and cell cycle) and the genetic perturbation used for the interactome study.
